def split_flat_reference
  (data : Slice Std.U8) (size : Std.Usize) (blocks : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)
  (tail : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  Result ((alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) × (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
  := do
  let i := Slice.len data
  let count ← i / size
  let consumed ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul count size)
  let blocks1 ← copy_range data 0#usize consumed blocks
  let i1 := Slice.len data
  let tail1 ← copy_range data consumed i1 tail
  ok (blocks1, tail1)
